classificationDefinitions.FULLY REVIEWED: Complete static source review; execution evidence is stated separately.
classificationDefinitions.PARTIALLY REVIEWED: Complete static source accounting, but environment-dependent behavior or browser execution remains unresolved.
classificationDefinitions.EXCLUDED: Outside the target inventory by an explicit scope rule.
classificationDefinitions.GENERATED: Generated or exported artifact reviewed for metadata and consumers, not authored semantics line by line.
classificationDefinitions.BINARY: Binary metadata and consumers reviewed; content was not source-reviewed.
classificationDefinitions.UNKNOWN: Origin or disposition could not be established.
